common.readOnly: Read-only: workspace admins can edit this section.
common.moduleOff: The “{module}” module is turned off for this business. Turn it on in Business setup → Industry.

setup.title: Business setup
setup.description: Your business details, hours and industry. Your AI agents use this information to answer.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.description: How your business introduces itself to customers.
profile.name: Business name
profile.typeDetailPlaceholder: e.g. Classic barbershop, Dental care, Italian food
profile.aboutPlaceholder: What your business does, what makes it different, key policies, payment methods…
profile.aboutHint: Your AI agents read this to get to know your business. Be clear and concrete.
profile.regionDescription: Currency for prices, time zone for scheduling and the business's main language.
profile.invalidTimezone: Invalid time zone. Pick one from the list (e.g. America/Mexico_City).

industry.title: Business type
industry.description: Sets the names your team sees, the available modules and how the AI behaves.
industry.modulesDescription: Turn on only what your business uses. Disabled modules are hidden from the menu and the AI won't offer them.

moduleHint.staff: People who serve customers, with their own schedules.
moduleHint.services: What you offer, with price and duration.

industry.capacityHint: How many are accepted at the same time when not assigned to a staff member (e.g. available tables).
industry.labelsDescription: Rename things the way your business calls them. Leave empty to use the suggested name.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.description: Weekly schedule in the business time zone ({tz}).
hours.invalidRange: {day}: closing time must be after opening time.
hours.invalidBreak: {day}: the break must fall within opening hours.

special.title: Special dates
special.description: Holidays, closures or different hours on a specific date.
special.invalidRange: End time must be after start time.

staff.description: Who serves customers and when they're available. The AI only offers free times of active {staff}.
staff.emptyDescription: Add your team with their days and hours so the AI can book.
staff.deleteDescription: Their availability is removed too. Existing bookings are kept, unassigned.
staff.editorDescription: Profile, weekly schedule, time off and what they offer.
staff.invalidShift: End time must be after start time.
staff.servicesHint: Tick the {services} they perform. If none is ticked, the AI may offer any.

field.name: Name
field.title: Role or specialty
field.bioHint: The AI may use it to introduce them.
field.memberHint: Optional: link it if they also answer chats.

availability.shiftHint: Without fixed slots, the AI offers any free time within this shift and the business hours.
availability.fixedHint: If a day has fixed slots, only those start times are offered. Click a slot to pause it.

exceptions.hint: Vacations, days off or different hours on one date.

services.description: The {services} you offer, with price and duration. The AI uses them to inform and book.
services.emptyDescription: Add them one by one or paste your price list and let the AI organize it.
services.editorDescription: Price in the business currency. Mark “From” if the price may vary.
services.deleteDescription: Existing bookings are kept without it.
services.invalidDuration: Duration must be between 5 and 1440 minutes.

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.description: Answers your AI agents use as-is. You can limit each one to some agents.
faqs.editorDescription: Write the answer the way you want the AI to give it.
faqs.emptyDescription: Add your customers' most common questions or import a document.
faqs.noAgents: No AI agents yet; it will be available to all.

field.question: Question
field.agentsHint: No selection = every agent can use it.

import.title: Import {items}
import.servicesHint: Paste your price list or menu (from Excel, Word, PDF…). The AI turns it into records you can review before saving.
import.faqsHint: Paste questions and answers or upload a document. Review the result before saving.
import.servicesPlaceholder:
Classic cut — $15 — 30 min
Cut + beard — from $25 — 45 min
import.faqsPlaceholder:
Do you take cards? Yes, all major cards.
Is there parking? …
import.fileTypes: Word, Excel, TXT or CSV · max 8 MB
import.review: Found {count}. Untick the ones you don't want to save.

dashboard.title: Business overview
dashboard.checklistDescription: The more complete it is, the better the AI answers.

logs.title: AI logs
logs.description: Every AI agent reply: what it understood, how confident it was and on which channel.
logs.emptyDescription: When an agent replies to a customer it will show up here.
